snippet.title: Path of Exile 2: Runes of Aldur - Runecrafting
snippet.description: The Return of the Ancients update is bringing a massive expansion to the rune system in Path of Exile 2 with the new Runes of Aldur league. Alongside a huge collection of brand-new runes to discover, many existing runes have also received significant buffs.
